According to the document, the Li-ion battery recycling market is projected to grow from $12.2 billion in 2025 to $18.1 billion by 2030. 

The growth in the Li-ion battery recycling market between 2025 and 2030 is $18.1 billion - $12.2 billion = $5.9 billion.

The annual growth rate is calculated as: (($18.1 billion - $12.2 billion) / $12.2 billion) / (2030 - 2025) = $5.9 billion / $12.2 billion / 5 = 0.096 or 9.6%.
